description: Create a subtask under a task. All time entries are logged against subtasks, so every task needs at least one. The subtask inherits a valid billing type from the parent task. Discover ids with find_billing_work - never ask the user for an id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

task_id.description: Id of the parent task (required). Must be a task in your organization.

name: create_subtask
